[[File:Oliver JN020.png|thumb|250px|Oliver]] '''Oliver''' (Japanese: '''セイヤ''' ''Seiya'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN020|Dreams Are Made of These!]]''. He is from [[Goldenrod City]]. During the [[Pokémon Orienteering]] competition, Oliver met {{Ash}} and challenged him to a Normal Class [[World Coronation Series]] {{pkmn|battle}}. He sent out his {{p|Meganium}} against [[Ash's Pikachu]], and despite having the type advantage, Meganium lost after a tough battle. Afterwards, he congratulated Ash and promised he would be victorious in the next battle. ==Pokémon== ===On hand=== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Oliver |pkmn=Meganium |nick=Stanium |type1=Grass |img=Oliver Stanium.png |epnum=JN020 |epname=Dreams Are Made of These! |vajp=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Soshina |vaen= |desc={{p|Meganium|Stanium}} (Japanese: '''ソシニウム''' ''Soshinium'') is Oliver's only known Pokémon. It was used to battle [[Ash's Pikachu]]. Stanium was able to gain the upper hand throughout the fight and land a {{m|Solar Beam}}, but was eventually defeated by Pikachu's {{m|Iron Tail}}. Stanium's known moves are {{m|Razor Leaf}}, {{m|Body Slam}}, and {{m|Solar Beam}}.}} ===Traveling with=== {| width="50%" |- | {{ActivePoké|||nick=Rotom Phone|Oliver Rotom Phone.png|electric|ghost|link=Rotom Phone}} | | |} ==Achievements== Oliver has competed in the following competitions: * [[World Coronation Series]] Rank: Unknown (Normal Class) ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{grass color light}}|bordercolor={{grass color dark}} |ja=せいや ''Seiya'' |en=[[Nicholas Corda]] |ar=علاء بيطار ''Alaa Bitar'' |id=Rahmad Ilmanto |fr_eu=Bruno Borsu |es_la=Edson Matus |es_eu=Carlos Bautista |pt_br=Gabriel Farias |pl=Karol Gajos |ca=Ismael Delic}} ==Trivia== * In the Japanese version, Seiya and Soshinium are named after and portrayed by Seiya and Soshina, who together form the Japanese comedy duo {{wp|Shimofuri Myojo}}. ** Shimofuri Myojo is based in Osaka.
